reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Illinois, focus year 2021)
    Question: Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Jurisdiction / focus year
% -----------------------------
jurisdiction(illinois).
focus_year(2021).

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -----------------------------
person(bailiff_1).
person_role(bailiff_1, bailiff).

% The writ at issue in the question.
writ(eviction_writ_1).
writ_type(eviction_writ_1, eviction).

/* No fact of the bailiff being a sheriff, nor a lawfully deputized officer.
   Under closed-world reasoning for these predicates, absence means "not proven". */

% Helper predicate required by prompt: succeeds when the scenario facts are satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(illinois),
    focus_year(2021),
    person(bailiff_1),
    person_role(bailiff_1, bailiff),
    writ(eviction_writ_1),
    writ_type(eviction_writ_1, eviction).

% -----------------------------
% General helper predicates about authority to execute eviction writs/orders
% -----------------------------
is_sheriff(Person) :-
    person_role(Person, sheriff).

is_lawfully_deputized_officer(Person) :-
    person_role(Person, officer),
    lawfully_deputized(Person).

/* "Sheriff or other lawfully deputized officers" are treated as empowered executors. */
executor_class(Person) :-
    is_sheriff(Person),
    !.
executor_class(Person) :-
    is_lawfully_deputized_officer(Person).

% -----------------------------
% Statute translations
% -----------------------------

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-119(e): Emergency subsidized housing eviction proceedings
   "... The sheriff or other lawfully deputized officers shall give priority to
    service and execution of orders entered under this Section ..."
   Encoded as: persons in executor_class/1 are empowered to execute such eviction orders.
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_119_executor(Person) :-
    executor_class(Person).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-120(f): Leased premises used in furtherance of a criminal offense
   "... The sheriff or other lawfully deputized officers shall execute an order
    entered pursuant to this Section within 7 days ..."
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_120_executor(Person) :-
    executor_class(Person).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-109.7: Stay of enforcement; drug related action
   "... The sheriff or other lawfully deputized officers shall execute an order
    entered pursuant to this Section within 7 days ..."
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_109_7_executor(Person) :-
    executor_class(Person).

/* Consolidated "empowered by law" executor rule derived from the above statutes.
   If any of these executor-authorizing statutes applies, the person is empowered.
   (For this question, the key statutory language is the executor class itself.)
*/
empowered_by_law_to_execute_eviction_writ(Person, Writ) :-
    writ_type(Writ, eviction),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_119_executor(Person),
    !.
empowered_by_law_to_execute_eviction_writ(Person, Writ) :-
    writ_type(Writ, eviction),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_120_executor(Person),
    !.
empowered_by_law_to_execute_eviction_writ(Person, Writ) :-
    writ_type(Writ, eviction),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_109_7_executor(Person).

% -----------------------------
% Additional statute encodings (not needed for the narrow executor question,
% but included to "translate the statutes" as requested)
% -----------------------------

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-119(b): applicability conditions for emergency subsidized housing
   This encodes the threshold structure in a reusable way.
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_119_applies(Complaint) :-
    complaint_seeks_possession(Complaint),
    complaint_premises_is_subsidized_housing(Complaint),
    complaint_alleges_refusal_to_allow_inspection_with_all_conditions(Complaint),
    complaint_notice_and_demand_served_at_least_days_before_hearing(Complaint, 14).

/* Minimal structure for the multi-part inspection refusal conditions from 9-119(b)(2). */
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_119_inspection_refusal_conditions(RefusalPacket) :-
    two_refusals_within_days(RefusalPacket, 30),
    landlord_sent_written_notice_after_two_refusals(RefusalPacket),
    tenant_failed_to_allow_inspection_within_days_after_notice(RefusalPacket, 30),
    lease_warns_eviction_possible_for_these_events(RefusalPacket).

complaint_alleges_refusal_to_allow_inspection_with_all_conditions(Complaint) :-
    complaint_refusal_packet(Complaint, RefusalPacket),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_119_inspection_refusal_conditions(RefusalPacket).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-120(a): lease voidable if premises used for felony or Class A misdemeanor. */
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_120_lease_voidable(Lease) :-
    leased_premises_used_for_offense(Lease, OffenseClass),
    ( OffenseClass = felony
    ; OffenseClass = class_a_misdemeanor
    ).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-120(b): assignment to State's Attorney / corporation counsel limited
   up to and including delivery of the eviction order to the sheriff for execution.
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_120_assignment_limit(Assignment, limit_to_delivery_to_sheriff_for_execution) :-
    assignment_in_writing(Assignment),
    assignment_to_state_attorney_or_corporation_counsel(Assignment).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-120(f): stay not in excess of 7 days (unless all parties agree to longer). */
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_120_stay_max_days(7).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-109.7: stay not in excess of 7 days in certain drug-related actions. */
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_109_7_stay_max_days(7).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-104.2(a-5): summarizes that execution is by sheriff/process server,
   and references execution of eviction order. We encode the service actor concept.
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_104_2_service_actor_allowed(sheriff).
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_104_2_service_actor_allowed(court_appointed_process_server).

% -----------------------------
% Answer logic (must be derived, not hardcoded)
% -----------------------------
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    empowered_by_law_to_execute_eviction_writ(bailiff_1, eviction_writ_1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------------
main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
